title: Cinematic — Voice-Command Payment Portal
prompt: Cinematic glassmorphic logo for a voice-first African fintech super-app, on a soft pearl-white mist background (#DDE8ED). The central symbol is a glowing circular portal formed from a single voice waveform that curves into a ring, with a neon-mint core (#69CEA9) at the center marking an approved transaction. Around the portal, two or three elegant electric-cyan (#70D0E0) orbit paths sweep like secure money routes, with soft aqua (#A9D3DF) glass glow. One subtle warm-gold accent (#F4DFA0) traces a short arc of the portal. Beneath, the wordmark 'ONGEA PESA' in a sleek high-tech rounded sans-serif, strong horizontal stance, deep-navy metallic gradient with cyan highlights (#2A5D73 to #70D0E0), exact spelling. Fast, smart, trustworthy, premium fintech, clean negative space, app-store ready.
negative_prompt: messy orb, currency particles, dollar signs, coins, transfer arrows, microphone, clutter, dark background, lens flare, misspelling, fake letters, low-res, distorted text

brand_lock.one_idea: waveform-portal ring + mint core + cyan orbit paths + 1 gold arc

notes: Decluttered 'Voice Command Payment Portal'. Best for landing-page hero, pitch deck, Safaricom/investor demo. The waveform-forms-a-portal is the strongest single concept of the five.
